acceptance_scenario_families: Choose one next owner and stop; ambiguity asks one discriminating question.
Detect and reconcile missing repository setup before engineering mutation.
Clarify domain meaning and keep durable decisions under their semantic owner.
Acquire bounded source or stakeholder evidence without transferring adoption authority.
Turn fog into settled source, specification, and dependency-ordered executable work.
Classify incoming work without fabricating readiness.
Choose a bounded design seam or disposable probe when technique is uncertain.
Separate uncertain diagnosis from settled red-green production proof.
Deliver one selected item or one explicit graph with isolated authority and exact closeout.
Resolve version-control conflicts while preserving both intended sides.
Keep ordinary diff review, high-risk release review, and immutable baseline audit distinct.
Improve or simplify code without hiding scope expansion or behavior change.
Author canonical skill semantics and prove behavior without assuming delivery authority.
Stress-test user-owned decisions with optional durable domain capture.
Preserve an exact resumable handoff when the active context ends.

exclusions: Incumbent skill bodies, current inventory count, or prior composition conclusions as discovery seeds
Runtime edits, campaign execution, efficacy claims, or pack acceptance
Historical cleanup, compatibility retirement, installation, push, or Git delivery
Universal optimality beyond this finite tested environment
intended_pack_outcome: Route bounded repository engineering work to one clear owner, conditionally load compact procedure, preserve semantic and mutation authority across typed composition, and converge under fresh observable proof in the tested Codex environment.
